rules.import_time_work: The code does work at module import time (top level): loads .env, builds models or clients, calls APIs, or opens files. Defining functions, classes, and constants is not work.
rules.model_id_outside_config: The code hard-codes a model ID string (such as 'gpt-5.6-luna' or 'glm-5.3') in a file other than configs/models_config.py.
rules.path_from_cwd: The code builds a filesystem location from the working directory (os.getcwd(), Path.cwd(), or a bare relative path like 'out/...') instead of importing it from paths_config.
rules.raw_message_content: The code reads a chat message's `.content` attribute directly instead of calling get_text(message).
rules.non_ascii_console: The code prints non-ASCII characters (emoji, arrows, Persian script) to the console.
rules.retry_around_model_call: The code wraps a model call (an LLM chain or chat model invoke) in its own retry loop or retry decorator.
rules.secrets_to_subprocess: The code gives a subprocess or shell that runs generated code the full process environment (os.environ), which includes secrets.
rules.identity_from_config: The code reads the user's identity from config['configurable'] or falls back to a default user id, instead of the runtime context.
